item.title: Zero-Downtime Postgres Schema Changes in 2026: pgroll vs Reshape vs graphile-migrate
item.description: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email_verified boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; on a table with 40 million rows takes a lock. In Postgres 11+ adding a column with a non-volatile default is metadata-only, so that particular statement is safe — but ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE, adding a constraint, or backfilling a new index will still queue behind every open transaction and block all writes behind it. One long-running analytics query, and your “quick migration” becomes a five-minute outage.
